scenarios.title: Sort the classic grid and restore it
scenarios.goal: Sort the fictional products by ascending price, verify the result, then restore name order.

scenarios.title: Sort the Compose grid and restore it
scenarios.goal: Sort the fictional Compose products by ascending price, verify the name and price pairing at both ends, then restore name order.

scenarios.title: Recover from a deterministic transient failure
scenarios.goal: Open the expedition status, recover from its temporary failure, verify that the expedition becomes ready, then reset the fixture.

scenarios.title: Use a canvas-only control
scenarios.goal: Open the canvas lab, reveal and report the painted token, then reset the fixture.

scenarios.title: Handle a real platform permission
scenarios.goal: Request notification permission, deny the Android dialog, verify the recorded result, then reset the fixture.

scenarios.title: Wait for a busy device lease
scenarios.goal: When the device becomes available, open the classic grid, verify its default order, then reset the fixture.

scenarios.title: Reuse a verified candidate flow
scenarios.goal: Sort the classic fictional products by ascending price, verify the result, then restore name order.
